description: This file defines an internal interface IDeploymentLoadPublisher within the Orleans.Runtime namespace, which inherits from ISystemTarget. The interface declares a single method UpdateRuntimeStatistics, marked as one-way, which takes in a SiloAddress and SiloRuntimeStatistics to update runtime statistics asynchronously.

methods.name: UpdateRuntimeStatistics
methods.description: An asynchronous method to update runtime statistics for a given silo address, marked as one-way to indicate one-way messaging.
